critical_code_review_comments: CoverflowRail fix is correct: setting SNAP=CARD_W (removing +10 gap) makes scrollX/SNAP exactly equal to the visually centered item index, since contentContainerStyle.paddingHorizontal = SIDE_PAD = (SCREEN_W - CARD_W)/2 so item i lands at viewport center when scrollX = i*CARD_W. Verified empirically: cx=195 with opacity=1 at rest, and messi(cx=186) with opacity=0.99 after +228 scroll.

Champion Detail redesign is well-structured with 9 distinct sections, StyleSheet keys prefixed by concern, and no visual overlap issues detected. All testIDs (svc-video/voice/training/tip, slot-*, book-btn) resolvable. Sticky bar bg=tokens.bg is fully opaque (rgb(7,17,31)).

JerseyBackground uses bundled asset + two Reanimated shared values for slow zoom+drift; correct fallback with base dark backgroundColor. Animation is native-driven (worklet-friendly withRepeat/withTiming), no jank observed.

rca_of_issue: PRIOR BUG RCA CONFIRMED FIXED — Previous iteration_3 identified that CoverflowRail's animation formula `distance = index - scrollX/snap` assumed scrollX/snap equals the visually centered item index, but with the old SNAP=CARD_W+10 and paddingHorizontal=SIDE_PAD, that assumption failed by ~one snap width (~180px). Applied fix: changed SNAP from CARD_W+10 to CARD_W (line 35 of CoverflowRail.tsx). Since paddingHorizontal=SIDE_PAD=(SCREEN_W-CARD_W)/2 and items have no marginRight, scrollX=i*CARD_W now places item i exactly at viewport center. Empirically verified: cr7 at cx=195 has scale/opacity=1.00 (previously scale=1 was at cx≈15). No regressions observed in booking flow or onboarding.
